Reject Pi startup on Codeon extension errors

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-69
  description: |-
    Treat an extension_error emitted for the explicitly loaded Codeon operation extension as a failed startup handshake, even when Pi returns a successful get_state response.
    
    Add a real Pi 0.84.2 regression that serves a colliding bash tool catalog and verifies PiSession::spawn fails closed.
